name: Basilisk
summary: A reptilian monstrosity whose gaze petrifies those who meet it.

bonusActions.name: Petrifying Gaze
bonusActions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/cone}. If the basilisk sees its reflection in the Cone, the basilisk must make this save. *First Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {ref:condition/restrained}, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/petrified} condition instead of the {ref:condition/restrained} condition.
